name: huit-aws
description: Log into HUIT AWS accounts from Claude Code. Default is the native aws login console-session attach into the default profile (HarvardKey in the browser, pick any role, credentials refreshed every 15 minutes, matching saved profiles refreshed too); the HUIT aws-login SAML CLI (one Okta Verify push) covers all mapped profiles at once. No IAM Identity Center, no long-lived keys.
